config.label: The email address for your Connect account
config.description: The email address for your Connect account. Stored only in your local .env; `npx trainbud setup` writes it for you.

config.label: Your Connect password
config.description: Your Connect password. Stored only in your local .env. Accounts with MFA enabled are not supported, because the unofficial library this drives cannot complete that flow.

config.label: Optional, and only for the watch app's Ask card and daily insight
config.description: Optional, and only for the watch app's Ask card and daily insight. The MCP tools themselves need no model key: every finding is computed in code, and the model only phrases it.
